name: msg life ag
summary: msg life ag provides software, advice, and cloud solutions for life insurance companies and pension fund institutions in Europe and the United States. The company offers msg.Insurance Suite for digitized insurance business; msg.Health Factory that covers life cycle of a health insurance contract; msg.ILIS, an insurance liability information system; msg.Life Group for collective business; msg.Life Factory for life insurance companies; msg.Pension portal for time value accounts and company pension plans; msg.Marsy-Pension for company pension commitments; msg.Ran, a pension settlement and documentation system; msg.Tax Connect, a software to optimize tax communication procedures; msg.Zulagenverwaltung for automated management of allowances processes; msg.ZVK Factory, a policy administration system for supplementary pension fund; and msg.Tax Data for automated management of tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates. It also provides msg. P&C Factory, a policy administration system for P&C insurance companies; msg.Billing collects and settles process; msg.Business Partner, a software for management of individuals and legal entities; msg.Commission controls and manages the sales structure; msg.Office, a digitized transaction control and document management solution; and msg.PMQ, a product management system. In addition, the company offers msg.Migration Archive, a software for archiving of historical contract data and peripheral system data; msg.Migration System that manages the transformation of data between the policy administration systems autonomously; msg.Sales platform for digital quotation and application processing; and msg.Online Insure, a customer self-service portal. Further, it offers the Unified Administration Platform; Unified Product Platform for Health; UAP.Reinsurance system; and Unified Distribution Platform. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Leinfelden-Echterdingen, Germany. msg life ag is a subsidiary of msg systems ag.
